noveltyJustification: Instruction, packaging, generated prompt and historical markdown mentions have different migration consequences.
keyQuestions: Which repository gates, CI workflows, documentation and external references become blockers?
What are the seven runtime resolution contracts, and which paths are configurable versus hardcoded?
answeredQuestions: AGENTS, README, CONTRIBUTING, PUBLIC-RELEASE and runtime sync docs contain live path contracts; generated prompts require regeneration; historical changelogs should remain historical.

ruledOut.reason: Some mentions are executable instructions or public packaging contracts, while historical changelogs intentionally preserve prior paths.

keyFindings.finding: AGENTS.md contains mandatory executable commands and runtime discovery paths.
README, CONTRIBUTING and PUBLIC-RELEASE define user-facing .opencode commands, layout and symlink packaging contracts.
Codex/Pi prompts embed .opencode source locations and are owned by prompt generators.
